name: JLVM Al-Jawad armoured security vehicle
armament: Open-top or armoured ring/turret mount for a 7.62 mm machine gun (often unarmed in PA service)
protection: Armoured steel body on a Ford F-550 truck chassis (Janes: 8.6 t gross weight), built as an internal-security vehicle against rifle fire and fragments; no MRAP-grade blast protection. Game: immune to small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R AP and larger penetrate the sides and disable tyres and engine; any launcher destroys it. Dimensions are approximate (F-550 chassis), pending a reference photo match.
visual_notes: Boxy armoured body on a conventional heavy-pickup chassis: separate long bonnet with a large grille, cab-forward box behind
4x4 with single rear wheels per side on the MK IV (two axles), large off-road tyres
Small armoured windows with thick glass, side and rear doors with firing ports
Roof hatch with ring mount or small open turret
PA vehicles usually plain sand or white/blue police livery with Arabic 'Palestinian National Security Forces' markings
variants: Al-Maha light armoured vehicle (Toyota Land Cruiser chassis, about 5.5 t; ordered for PA forces in 2022)
